_about: Read by .tools/sync/sync_engine_skills.py and refresh_kit_skills.py. `generated` lists the kit skills that Chaos Redux generates from the pinned snapshot in this folder. `skills`, `agents` and `instruction_files` map the kit names that can appear in a generated skill's text to their Chaos Redux names; the generator replaces whole names only. Agent routing names use underscores (hoi4_portrait_creator); the kit's hyphenated agent file names are not replaced because they collide with skill names (hoi4-3d-model-pipeline is both a skill and an agent). `not_replaced` and `no_counterpart` are documentation only.

not_replaced.xlsx: chaos-redux-xlsx is the Chaos Redux counterpart of the kit's xlsx skill; the bare word is not replaced because it also names the .xlsx file type

skills.hoi4-comfyui: Chaos Redux generates images through the gptimage MCP route in chaos-redux-event-assets
skills.hoi4-live-playtest: Chaos Redux has one live-testing skill, chaos-redux-debug-playtest, which covers both kit skills; the kit's hoi4-investigate names hoi4-live-playtest, so chaos-redux-investigate explains that in its overlay
skills.hoi4-portrait-production: portrait production lives in chaos-redux-event-assets and the chaosx_portrait_creator agent
skills.hoi4-text-audio-research: no Chaos Redux skill; the chaosx_super_event_text_researcher and chaosx_super_event_audio_researcher agents carry the work

agents.hoi4_audio_researcher: closest is chaosx_super_event_audio_researcher, whose description is the kit's general audio researcher
agents.hoi4_super_event_art_researcher: none; chaosx_asset_source_researcher and chaosx_generated_event_art cover art
